episodes.name: Who Smarted?
episodes.overview: Worried that he's not smart enough for Hayley, Jeff undergoes an experimental intelligence enhancement procedure at the CIA. Roger recruits Steve to help him harvest snake venom.

episodes.name: Russian Doll
episodes.overview: Stan becomes infatuated with a doll that the CIA wants to use to spy on the Russians.

episodes.name: Stan Moves to Chicago
episodes.overview: Stan moves to Chicago to become a comic while Steve and Hayley host Roger for a nice night in.

episodes.name: Shakedown Steve
episodes.overview: Steve and Jeff try to bond as brothers while the rest of the family visits an escape room.

episodes.name: Klaus and Rogu in "Thank God for Loose Rocks": An American Dad! Adventure
episodes.overview: When the family goes to a dude ranch, Klaus and Rogu have to work together to survive in the wilderness.

episodes.name: The Wondercabinet
episodes.overview: Steve spins out about his future, but a radio show about new age mysticism gives him a hopeful new understanding of life. Roger struggles to get into the adult film industry.

episodes.name: Little Bonnie Ramirez
episodes.overview: After a series of boring personas, Roger goes to great lengths to prove to Francine he still has "his edge".

episodes.name: Dancin' A-With My Cells
episodes.overview: Stan tries a new, cutting edge parenting approach DNA splicing.

episodes.name: Mused and Abused
episodes.overview: Roger reveals a secret passion to Klaus; Stan and Francine seek revenge on Bazooka Sharks management.

episodes.name: Henderson
episodes.overview: Stan's childhood imaginary friend returns to collect a debt. Klaus has a big date and needs a fishbowl upgrade.

episodes.name: Hot Scoomp
episodes.overview: Hayley searches for guidance and instead finds a community of 'cool butts.'

episodes.name: Lumberjerk
episodes.overview: Stan is forced to partner with Jeff in a lumberjack competition; Steve, Francine and Snot enter a contest to win a vintage pickup truck.

episodes.name: Stan & Francine & Stan & Francine & Radika
episodes.overview: Stan and Francine go back in time to settle an argument.

episodes.name: Flush After Reading
episodes.overview: Francine and Roger get lost in a good book -- or five -- after Francine escapes an embarrassing situation; Stan reluctantly hangs out at the library.

episodes.name: Comb Over: A Hair Piece
episodes.overview: Stan finally decides to do something about his secret baldness and enlists the help of Josay Bosay, Roger's famed hair-stylist-to-the-stars persona.

episodes.name: Plot Heavy
episodes.overview: After Stan sells off the coveted family plot, the family opens their own cemetery in the backyard with the help of basketball Hall-of-Famer Scottie Pippen.

episodes.name: The Sinister Fate!!
episodes.overview: A new friendship causes Hayley to start worrying she might be slowly turning into Francine. Steve and his friends try out for Roger's improv troupe.

episodes.name: Dr. Sunderson's SunSuckers
episodes.overview: Hayley and Jeff help one of Roger's personas run a solar company.

episodes.name: Family Time
episodes.overview: Stan and the family go out to dinner at a buffet restaurant. Roger becomes a flower.

episodes.name: Cry Baby
episodes.overview: When Stan realizes he can't cry, he asks Steve to teach him empathy.

episodes.name: Crystal Clear
episodes.overview: Stan gets in over his head trying to impress Toshi's dad; Klaus and Jeff head to the country for a weekend getaway.

episodes.name: Steve's Franken Out
episodes.overview: When Principal Lewis threatens to cancel science club, Steve takes matters into his own hands in a monstrous way.
